scope: Targeted existing max_by execution; Spark-only AvailableNow aggregate counterexample, not Sail streaming or CDC qualification

cases.name: max_by_struct
cases.sql: SELECT max_by(named_struct('id', id, 'seq', seq), seq) AS winner FROM VALUES (1, 10), (2, 20) AS t(id, seq)

cases.name: max_by_null_order
cases.sql: SELECT max_by(named_struct('id', id, 'seq', seq), seq) AS winner FROM VALUES (1, CAST(NULL AS INT)), (2, 20) AS t(id, seq)

cases.name: max_by_all_null_order
cases.sql: SELECT max_by(named_struct('id', id, 'seq', seq), seq) AS winner FROM VALUES (1, CAST(NULL AS INT)), (2, CAST(NULL AS INT)) AS t(id, seq)
